package.name: nidar_perception
package.description: Camera bringup and survivor detection for NIDAR: the camera_link TF chain, the YOLO person detector with ground-plane back-projection and NN tracking, and the model weights it loads. Publishes /survivors (nidar_msgs/SurvivorArray) and /survivor_markers. Survivor grid-cell math for display lives in nidar_map2d.
